chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibrahim from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When the sun sets on the Day of Arafah, cease the Talbiyah at the time of the sun's setting."

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: the recitation of Talbiyah (Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk)

ai.seo_question: When should a pilgrim stop reciting Talbiyah during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* specifies the precise moment to conclude the Talbiyah, linking it to the solar zenith (Zawal) on the Day of Arafah rather than sunset, which aligns with the majority of Shia jurists. This timing marks the transition from the state of Ihram preparation to the core ritual of standing at Arafah, emphasizing the importance of synchronizing ritual acts with the celestial signs as understood in Shia fiqh. The ruling underscores the meticulous attention to temporal details in Hajj rituals, distinguishing it from other schools that may vary on the exact cutoff point.
